summary.text: Tim Teagan, a Libertarian Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 6th District to Debbie Dingell.
Nominated at the party's June 28, 2026 convention, Teagan serves as chair of the Libertarian Party of Michigan.
Tim Teagan received 0.7% of the vote to Debbie Dingell's 67.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
